About the Practice

Columbia University Irving Medical Center (CUIMC) is a clinical, research, and educational enterprise in northern Manhattan, serving as the academic medical center of Columbia University and a major campus of NewYork-Presbyterian Hospital. CUIMC leads in providing comprehensive, innovative, and state-of-the-art patient care across more than 230 specialties and subspecialties, including general and specialized medical, dental, and nursing services. It is home to four professional colleges and schools: the Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons, College of Dental Medicine, School of Nursing, and Mailman School of Public Health. Electronic Health Record System

Epic

Primary Electronic Health Record System

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

Columbia University Irving Medical Center (CUIMC) uses a patient portal called "Connect". This portal is a single access point for patients of CUIMC, NewYork-Presbyterian, and Weill Cornell Medicine. CUIMC, along with NewYork-Presbyterian, transitioned to the Connect patient portal and the Epic electronic medical record system on February 1, 2020. This indicates that the Connect patient portal is provided by Epic, similar to how MyChart is an Epic patient portal. Therefore, Columbia University Irving Medical Center is using Epic as their EHR vendor.
